# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2004

**Kautusang Bayan Blg. 03**

## Summary

Municipal Ordinance No. 03 (Kautusang Bayan Blg. 03), Series of [[2004]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on February 16, 2004. This is a comprehensive solid waste management ordinance establishing updated policies and regulations for waste management in the municipality, in compliance with Republic Act No. 9003 (Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2001). It covers waste storage, collection, disposal, definition of terms, establishment of Barangay Solid Waste Management Boards, creation of a Municipal Solid Waste Management Plan, incentive programs, awards, and penalties.

## Key Provisions

### Article I - Purpose, Coverage, and Objectives
- **Section 1 (Purpose)** — This Municipal Ordinance shall be known as the "Updated Policies and Regulations on Solid Waste Management in the Municipality of Pitogo, Province of Quezon."
- **Section 2 (Coverage)** — Applies to all barangays within the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon, in compliance with RA 9003 (Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2001).
- **Section 3 (Objectives)** — To promote a clean and healthy environment; to protect natural resources; to encourage proper waste segregation and recycling; and to establish an organized system for solid waste collection and disposal.
- **Section 4 (Scope)** — Applies to all residents, establishments, institutions, and organizations within the municipality, and shall be enforced by the Punong Barangay, Barangay Tanod, DENR, Environment and Natural Resources Officer, and Barangay Police.

### Article II - Definition of Terms
- Defines key terms including: Biodegradable, Composting, Non-biodegradable, Recycling, Municipal Waste, Solid Waste Management, Ecological Solid Waste Management System, Yard Waste, Solid Waste, Segregation, Hazardous Waste, Agricultural Waste, Disposal, Controlled Dumpsite, and Sanitary Landfill.

### Article III - Provisions on Waste Storage
- **Section 1** — All owners of residences, commercial establishments, and institutions must have proper waste storage containers classified as biodegradable, compostable, or recyclable/non-biodegradable.
- **Section 2** — Waste containers must be kept in appropriate locations within the property.
- **Section 3** — Clinics, pharmacies, and similar establishments must have separate containers for their waste to prevent contamination.

### Article IV - Provisions on Waste Collection and Transport
- **Section 1** — Waste containers shall be placed alongside roads and intersections along the route of waste collection trucks.
- **Section 2** — Non-biodegradable and non-recyclable waste must be placed in bags and containers for collection by the waste truck.

### Article V - Provisions on Waste Disposal
- **Section 1** — Proper disposal of solid waste (including halimbawa or examples such as tree branches, leaves, and similar organic waste) at designated disposal areas.
- **Section 2** — Prohibits improper waste disposal in the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon.
- **Section 3** — Barangay authorities shall designate areas within their jurisdiction for temporary waste storage.
- **Section 4** — Prohibits disposal of hazardous waste materials, including chemicals, at public utility areas.
- **Section 5** — Encourages the use of "composting methods" for waste disposal by organizations, cooperatives, and private entities.
- **Section 6** — Establishes a "Controlled Disposal" zone for non-biodegradable, non-recyclable, and non-reusable materials at a designated Sanitary Landfill in accordance with RA 9003.
- **Section 7** — Prohibits open burning of waste.
- **Section 8** — Prohibits any person from intentionally causing waste accumulation resulting in pollution.
- **Section 9** — Prohibits the stockpiling or hoarding of waste materials in residential areas, commercial establishments, and industrial zones within the municipality.
- **Section 10** — Prohibits littering or throwing of waste in public spaces during any day or time.

### Article VI - Barangay Solid Waste Management Board
- **Section 1** — Establishes Barangay Solid Waste Management Boards, chaired by the Punong Barangay, with members including: Kagawad ng Barangay, Pangulo ng Federasyon ng Sangguniang Kabataan, Punong-guro, Parent Teacher Association, Samahang di-pampamahalaan (NGO), Kalihim Pambarangay, Kinatawan mula sa Samahang Pananamihan, and Kinatawan mula sa Samahan ng mga Negosyante.
- Board responsibilities include: formulating waste management programs, promoting waste segregation, maintaining cleanliness and sanitation.

### Article VII - Municipal Solid Waste Management Plan
- **Section 1** — Establishes a Municipal Solid Waste Management Plan to guide municipal-wide waste management programs.

### Article I (Incentives)
- **Section 1** — Thirty percent (30%) of incentives shall go to barangay organizations, with Twenty percent (20%) going to the barangay for its incentive programs, and Fifty percent (50%) to the LGU of Pitogo.

### Article VIII - Awards (Pagkakaloob ng Gantimpala)
- **Section 1** — Establishes an Awards Committee to recognize outstanding performance in waste management compliance.

### Article IX - Penalties
- **Section 1** — For violations of Article I, Section 5(a), (b), (g), (h), Article III, Sections 1-3, Article IV, Sections 1-2, and Article 2-8:
  - First offense: P200 fine or two (2) hours community service
  - Second offense: P500 fine or ten (10) hours community service
  - Third offense: P1,000 fine or sixteen (16) hours community service
- **Section 2** — For violations of Article I, Section 5(d), (e), (j), (k), Article IV, Section 5:
  - First offense: P500 fine or four (4) hours community service
  - Second offense: P1,000 fine or ten (10) hours community service
  - Third offense: P1,500 fine or equivalent community service as determined by the court
- **Section 3** — For violations of Article IV, Section 3:
  - First offense: P1,000 fine or suspension of Business Permit
  - Second offense: P1,500 fine or suspension of Business Permit
  - Third offense: P2,500 fine or suspension of Business Permit
- **Section 4** — For violations of Article I, Sections 1, 5-7:
  - First offense: P100 fine or ten (10) hours community service
  - Second offense: P1,500 fine or twelve (12) hours community service
  - Third offense: P2,500 fine or as determined by law
- **Section 6** — If violator is a corporation, commercial establishment, or institution, the Punong Barangay, Tagapamahala, manager, or director shall be held liable.

### Article X - Separability
- If any provision of this ordinance is declared invalid, the remaining provisions shall remain in effect.

### Article XI - Repealing Clause
- All conflicting existing ordinances or parts thereof are hereby repealed.

### Article XII - Effectivity
- This ordinance shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its posting in conspicuous places.
